messages.text: He Sarah , as someone told George that the Heliumdeploy App website wasnt working , me and my friend tried mutiple multiple way ( Chrome , Edge and Iphone ) . There always the same error saying Failed to Fetch
Handed to the team · App site error I can't resolve from the store chat

Sorry about that — the team has the app issue now and will confirm by email, usually within a business day. Stay in the chat if you can and they may jump in here.

Meanwhile, anything you want to know about the Magic Miner 40T on your screen?
I dont need to stay , im just friendly reporting the issue to you guys that sit :P

Appreciated — genuinely useful, the team's on it now.

Before you go, one thing: what brought you to the Magic Miner 40T page today?
Just looking to see where was Batch 7 going

Batch 7 is live at $799, ships November 30, 2026.

What are you watching the batches for — holding out for a better date, or a second unit?
Im in batch 5 alrerady , just sniffing around :P

Nice, Batch 5's the team's "no chances" date, so you're in a good spot.

What made you go 40T rather than one of the smaller units?
I had 5 bitaxe , looking to get someting that I can heat a room a little and increase my chance on BCH

650 W will take the chill off a small room nicely, and 40 TH on a BCH solo pool is a real step up from five Bitaxes.

That's me done pestering you — thanks for the report and for the answers. Shout if you want anything checked before Batch 5 lands.
No im good , one day Sarah will go for a steak diner together :P
Ha — I'll stick to miners, but the sentiment's appreciated. Enjoy the Batch 5 wait, and come back if anything needs checking.
